抽帧间隔：X秒一帧，取值范围[1, 10]，间隔越大模型能提取到的信息越少，耗时越长，成本越高，默认已是最佳实践，一般无需修改，如果要修改，请根据视频时长来定，建议[1~3]。

description.en: Frame sampling interval: One frame every X seconds. Range: \[1, 10]. Larger intervals reduce extracted information, increase processing time, and raise costs. Default settings follow best practices and usually require no changes. If adjusting, consider video length and use \[1–3]. Note: This parameter takes precedence over frameSampleMethod.interval. For most scenarios, use frameSampleMethod in “userdefined” mode, where interval must stay within the valid range for the video’s duration.

## API-SDK调用说明
### API接口说明

调用视频理解API有**2**种方式，对应2个接口

- 调用[离线异步API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-submitvideoanalysistask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_1.3b2e46c2wjL7dc&scm=20140722.H_2867156._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1)（**推荐**）：默认支持2并发，可以通过配置接口调整并发到10，如果业务量大，可以联系客服（或运营等）申请更多并发，无需等待执行结束，异步调度，并发数等于后台同时跑的任务数，超过并发数的任务会排队，sdk支持绝大部分开发语言，openapi门户可以直接调试和使用，也可以到[**轻应用-影视传媒视频理解**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend)控制台，切换到“API” 页签下查看调用demo。

- 调用[在线同步API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-runvideoanalysis?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_0.396c36b9Pjqtm9&scm=20140722.H_2846254._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1)（**不推荐**）：本文档对应接口，全局只有**1**并发，需保持链接等待结果，sdk支持的语言有限（java、python），openapi门户页面不支持调试和调用（sse）（copy出来代码无法直接使用），一般少量体验用，调用需到[**轻应用-影视传媒视频理解**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend)控制台，切换到“API” 页签下查看调用demo。

### 在线同步API调用说明

推荐**Java（异步sdk）、Python**语言的SDK，其中
Java（异步sdk）依赖如下：

```JSON
<dependency>
   <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
   <artifactId>alibabacloud-quanmiaolightapp20240801</artifactId>
   <version>取最新版本</version>
 </dependency>
```

- 获取[Java（异步）最新版本依赖](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/QuanMiaoLightApp?version=2024-08-01&language=java-async-tea&tab=primer-doc)。

- 获取[AccessKey ID、AccessKey Secret](~~2587494~~)。

- 获取[业务空间ID（Workspace ID）](~~2782167~~)。

## 权限说明

### 前置条件
- 登录阿里云百炼控制台，确认阿里云百炼是开通可用状态。
- 主账号调用：默认有所有API调用权限。
- 子账号调用：子账号默认无权限（AccessForbid）调用当前API，需要同时在**RAM控制台**和**阿里云百炼控制台**中做授权。

### RAM控制台授权说明

去[RAM控制台](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/users)授权，具体RAM授权操作，参考[RAM文档](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/create-a-custom-policy)，步骤如下：

#### 方案一（推荐）：授予内置权限策略 

授予子账号”[AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess/System/content)“ 权限。

如果要同时访问控制台，请同时授予”[AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess/System/content)“权限。

#### 方案二：自定义授权策略并赋予权限

适用于精细化管理API维度访问的场景。

- **自定义授权策略**：菜单“**权限管理-权限策略**”下，创建权限策略，脚本编辑方式录入如下任意一个方案中json。
授权子子账号指定接口，比如视频理解“RunVideoAnalysis”。

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "quanmiaolightapp:RunVideoAnalysis",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

如果要同时访问控制台，请同时授予如下接口权限。

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "aimiaobi:GetVideoAnalysisConfig",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

- **给子账号授权**：菜单“**身份管理-用户**”下，找到对应用户，新增授权，切换自定义授权，添加上面自定义的授权策略。

### 阿里云百炼控制台授权说明

使用主账号或有阿里云百炼管理员权限的子账号，登录阿里云百炼控制台，在[权限管理-用户管理](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/authority)页面添加子账号。

## 接口部分入参取值说明
### 抽帧配置字段（frameSampleMethod）
用于调整抽帧的参数，包括抽帧间隔、抽帧像素。抽帧方式默认为标准方式，目前共提供三种方式可供选择，标准、快速/更低成本、自定义。
- 使用“标准”方式进行抽帧时，应用系统内置参数进行抽帧，抽帧间隔与抽帧像素无需用户自定义。标准方式抽帧间隔和抽帧像素取值规则为：
	- 根据视频时长选择不同档位，具体请参见[视频理解控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend)，“效果调试”页签下的高级功能 > 抽帧方式 > 自定义中的“推荐取值范围1.0 ~6.0”和“推荐取值范围650 ~ 750”右侧的“？”提示信息。
	- 视频时长和档位映射关系为：取视频时长和档位时长举例最近的档，如果相同，取档位时长大的。
- 使用“快速/更低成本”方式进行抽帧时，应用系统内置参数系数运算后的结果进行抽帧，抽帧间隔与抽帧像素无需用户自定义。
- 使用“自定义”方式时，则需要用户传入抽帧间隔、抽帧像素两个参数，参数的取值范围对不同时长的视频存在不同的限制，取值范围具体计算规则如下：
    - 最小抽帧间隔 = max("标准"方式对应抽帧间隔 - 0.2，1)
    - 最大抽帧间隔 = "标准"方式对应抽帧间隔 + 5
    - 最小抽帧像素 = max("标准"方式对应抽帧像素 - 50，300)
    - 最大抽帧像素 = "标准"方式对应抽帧像素 + 50

descriptions.en:
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Light App – Video Understanding: This API accepts a video input and performs tasks such as caption extraction, video content analysis, video summarization, title generation, and mind map creation. You can also use a custom prompt to generate differentiated video content.

- Try it directly at [Light App – Video Understanding for Film and Media](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend).

- To call the API using an SDK, refer to the examples under the “API” tab in the Video Understanding console.
  ><notice>When calling this API via SDK, note that the **Debug** section of the OpenAPI portal has limited support for the SSE protocol. We recommend following the **call examples**. For details, go to [**Light App – Video Understanding for Film and Media**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) and switch to the **API tab**.></notice>

## API and SDK usage

### API overview

There are **2** ways to call the Video Understanding API, corresponding to two endpoints:

- Call the [asynchronous offline API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-submitvideoanalysistask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_1.3b2e46c2wjL7dc\&scm=20140722.H_2867156._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) (**recommended**): Supports 2 concurrent requests by default. You can increase concurrency up to 10 through configuration. For higher workloads, contact customer support (or operations) to request additional concurrency. This method does not require waiting for execution to complete, uses asynchronous scheduling, and the concurrency limit equals the number of tasks running simultaneously in the backend. Tasks exceeding the concurrency limit are queued. The SDK supports most programming languages, and you can debug or use the API directly in the OpenAPI portal. You can also view demo code in the [**Light App – Video Understanding for Film and Media**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) console under the “API” tab.

- Call the [synchronous online API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-runvideoanalysis?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_0.396c36b9Pjqtm9\&scm=20140722.H_2846254._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) (**not recommended**): This document describes this endpoint. It supports only **1** global concurrent request. You must keep the connection open while waiting for results. The SDK supports only Java and Python. The OpenAPI portal does not support debugging or calling this endpoint via SSE (copied code cannot be used directly). Use this method only for light testing. View demo code in the [**Light App – Video Understanding for Film and Media**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) console under the “API” tab.

### Synchronous online API usage

We recommend using the SDK for Java (asynchronous SDK) or **Python**. The Java (asynchronous SDK) dependency is as follows:

```JSON
<dependency>
   <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
   <artifactId>alibabacloud-quanmiaolightapp20240801</artifactId>
   <version>Use the latest version</version>
 </dependency>
```

- Obtain the [latest Java (asynchronous) dependency](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/QuanMiaoLightApp?version=2024-08-01\&language=java-async-tea\&tab=primer-doc).

- Obtain your [AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret](~~2587494~~).

- Obtain your [Workspace ID](~~2782167~~).

## Permissions

### Prerequisites

- Log on to the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console and confirm that the service is active and available.

- Alibaba Cloud account calls: Full API access permissions are granted by default.

- RAM user calls: RAM users have no permissions (AccessForbid) to call this API by default. You must grant permissions in both the **RAM console** and the **Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console**.

### RAM console authorization

Go to the [RAM console](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/users) to grant permissions. For detailed steps, see the [RAM documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/create-a-custom-policy):

#### Option 1 (recommended): Grant a built-in policy

Grant the RAM user the [AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess/System/content) permission.

To also allow console access, grant the [AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess/System/content) permission.

#### Option 2: Create and assign a custom policy

Use this option for fine-grained control over API-level access.

- **Create a custom authorization policy**: Under the **Permission Management > Policies** menu, create a policy using the script editor. Use one of the following JSON examples to authorize specific APIs, such as RunVideoAnalysis for video understanding.

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "quanmiaolightapp:RunVideoAnalysis",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

To also allow console access, grant the following API permission:

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "aimiaobi:GetVideoAnalysisConfig",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

- **Assign the policy to a RAM user**: Under the **Identity Management > Users** menu, find the target user, add a new authorization, switch to custom policies, and attach the policy you created above.

### Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console authorization

Use your Alibaba Cloud account or a RAM user with administrative permissions for Model Studio to log on to the console. Add the RAM user on the [Permission Management > User Management](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/authority) page.

## Input parameter value guidelines

### Frame sampling configuration (frameSampleMethod)

These parameters control frame sampling, including interval and resolution. The default sampling method is Standard. Three methods are available: Standard, Fast/Lower Cost, and Custom.

- When using the “Standard” method, the system applies built-in parameters. You do not need to define the interval or pixel values. The rules for these values are:

  - Based on video duration, the system selects a preset tier. See the “?” tooltip next to “Recommended range 1.0–6.0” and “Recommended range 650–750” under Advanced Features > Frame Sampling Method > Custom in the [Video Understanding console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend), under the “Effect Debugging” tab.

  - Map video duration to the nearest tier. If equidistant, choose the tier with the longer duration.

- When using the “Fast/Lower Cost” method, the system applies internally calculated parameters. You do not need to define interval or pixel values.

- When using the “Custom” method, you must provide both interval and pixel values. Valid ranges depend on video duration and are calculated as follows:

  - Minimum interval = max(Standard interval − 0.2, 1)

  - Maximum interval = Standard interval + 5

  - Minimum pixel = max(Standard pixel − 50, 300)

  - Maximum pixel = Standard pixel + 50
